classification.resume: The record is an archival file reference for documentation related to the International Congress of Art History held in London in 1939, held within the Swiss Federal Archives. It does not contain the congress proceedings or media itself but points to administrative files from the Federal Department of the Interior regarding support for scientific and charitable organizations. The document is a finding aid entry describing the archival context of the record.
